blocks.orig: Turaco Ngorongoro Valley is a stunning accommodation in Karatu, close to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The lodge is marked by elegant decor and lovely furnishings, surrounded by lush tropical greenery. It offers 4 suites – 2 villas, a studio and a penthouse. The penthouse and one of the two villas hold space for 4 people, while all the other rooms offer space for 2. All rooms feature king-size beds, a spacious bathroom with a shower and whirlpool, a seating lounge, and a private balcony with a garden view. The lodge also features an outdoor terrace, a well-equipped fitness centre, a beautiful spa, an outdoor pool, and a restaurant serving a full American breakfast, as well as vegetarian, halal, and continental options for dinner.
blocks.html: In Karatu, near the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Turaco Ngorongoro Valley is a beautiful place to stay. Elegant decor and attractive furnishings define the lodge, which is set amid lush tropical greenery. There are 4 suites – 2 villas, a studio and a penthouse. The penthouse and one of the villas sleep 4 people, and the remaining rooms sleep 2. Each room has a king-size bed, a roomy bathroom with shower and whirlpool, a lounge area and a private balcony looking onto the garden. Guests can also use the outdoor terrace, a well-equipped fitness centre, a lovely spa and an outdoor pool, and the restaurant serves a full American breakfast plus vegetarian, halal and continental choices at dinner.
